typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	create_time as string ('20220318'),
	filename_prefix as string ('ib_kpma_callbacks'),
	output_prefix as string ('ob_kpma_callbacks')
}
source(output(
		Timestamp as string,
		Level as string,
		OperationName as string,
		OperationItem as string,
		Message as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: true,
	modifiedAfter: (toTimestamp($create_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd\'T\'HH:mm:ss')),
	wildcardPaths:[(concat('error_log/', $filename_prefix, '/*/*/*/*.txt'))]) ~> errorReject
source(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: true,
	wildcardPaths:[(concat('reject_map/', $filename_prefix, '*'))]) ~> sourceReject
source(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:[(concat('curated/', $filename_prefix, '*'))]) ~> curatedRaw
errorReject filter(OperationName == 'TabularRowSkip') ~> Filter1
Filter1 derive(ADFId__c = split(replace(OperationItem, '"', ''), ',')[1]) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON = Message
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
sourceReject, Select1 union(byName: true)~> Union1
DerivedColumn2, Union1 join(DerivedColumn2@ADFId__c == Union1@ADFId__c,
	joinType:'inner',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'right')~> Join1
curatedRaw derive(ADFId__c = toString(byName('ADFId__c')),
		FILE_NAME = replace(replace(concat('reject_files/', split(byName('FILE_NAME'), '/')[4]), '.csv', '_reject.csv'), 'ib_', 'ob_')) ~> DerivedColumn2
Join1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	rowUrlColumn:'FILE_NAME',
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	quoteAll: true,
	mapColumn(
		each(match(name!='ADFId__c'))
	)) ~> FinalReject
